Two-pointer: track left_max and right_max. O(n) O(1).

For trap rain water basic I will move the smaller of left/right max inward.

```python
def trap(heights):
    lo, hi = 0, len(heights) - 1
    lm, rm, water = 0, 0, 0
    while lo < hi:
        if heights[lo] < heights[hi]:
            lm = max(lm, heights[lo])
            water += lm - heights[lo]
            lo += 1
        else:
            rm = max(rm, heights[hi])
            water += rm - heights[hi]
            hi -= 1
    return water
```
